aboutStory.paragraph1: Hotel Sherpa Soul is a small hotel in Thamel, Kathmandu, created for travellers who value comfort, convenience and a good night's sleep.
aboutStory.paragraph2: For us, hospitality is not about having the biggest building or the longest list of facilities. It is about getting the important things right: a clean and comfortable room, a convenient location, a peaceful environment, helpful service and a warm welcome when you arrive in Kathmandu.
aboutStory.paragraph3: We understand that many travellers spend most of their day exploring the city or travelling through Nepal. When they return to the hotel, they want somewhere comfortable to relax and recharge.

faq.title: Everything You Need to Know
faq.subtitle: Clear, practical answers about our rooms, quiet atmosphere, shared kitchen, and Thamel location.
faq.helpSubtitle: We are happy to help you choose the right room and plan your stay in Kathmandu.
faq.q1: Where is Hotel Sherpa Soul located?
faq.a1: Hotel Sherpa Soul is located in Thamel, Kathmandu, Nepal, a popular area for travellers and visitors to Kathmandu.
faq.a2: Hotel Sherpa Soul offers three room categories: Solo Comfort Room for single occupancy, Double Comfort Room for two guests, and Triple Comfort Room for three guests.
faq.q3: Is Hotel Sherpa Soul a hotel with a restaurant?
faq.a3: No. Hotel Sherpa Soul does not operate a restaurant. Our focus is on comfortable accommodation and a peaceful environment for our guests.
faq.a4: Private parking is not available at the hotel. Guests who need parking should contact the hotel before arrival for information about nearby options.
faq.q5: Do the rooms have air conditioning?
faq.a5: Air conditioning is available as a room facility where specified. Guests should check the selected room category for exact facilities.
faq.a6: Yes, Wi-Fi is provided for guests to stay connected during their visit.
faq.q7: Does the hotel have a shared kitchen?
faq.a7: Yes. Hotel Sherpa Soul provides a shared self-use kitchen for registered guests, particularly useful for longer stays. Please check the current kitchen facilities and house rules with the hotel.
faq.q8: Who can use the shared kitchen?
faq.a8: The shared kitchen is intended for registered hotel guests. Guests are expected to clean after use and respect other guests sharing the facility.
faq.a9: The hotel is approximately 20 minutes from Tribhuvan International Airport by vehicle, depending on traffic.
faq.a10: Pashupatinath Temple is approximately 15 minutes away by vehicle, depending on traffic.
faq.a11: Boudhanath Stupa is approximately 20 minutes away by vehicle, depending on traffic.
faq.q12: How can I book a room?
faq.a12: You can book directly through our website or contact the hotel directly via WhatsApp or phone to check availability.
